title: Fixing invalidation bugs
hints: For `appendSquares`, remember the original size and loop over indices: indices stay meaningful after a reallocation, iterators do not. (`reserve` first also works, if you read its guarantee carefully.)
`erase` returns the iterator to the element after the one removed. Advance with `++it` only when you did not erase. For vectors, `std::erase_if` does the whole job in one linear pass.
